decisive_items: Mild hypoaesthesia on the extensor side of the knee and ankle
Earlobe tissue fluid showed acid-fast bacilli (Bacterial Index 4.8)
response.rationale: Chronic painless nodules, hypoaesthesia, and abundant acid-fast bacilli with high bacterial index strongly indicate leprosy (likely lepromatous). Lupus vulgaris also shows AFB but typically lacks the neurological findings and livedo reticularis pattern.

rejected.why: Erythema nodosum leprosum is a reactive episode, not the primary diagnosis; nodules here are painless and chronic.
Erythema nodosum is typically painful and lacks AFB on histology.
Sarcoidosis shows non-caseating granulomas, not AFB-laden foamy histiocytes.
Autoantibodies are nonspecific; histopathology with AFB excludes lupus as the cause of nodules.
